name: pulse-existing-audit
description: Audits existing React components, hooks, utilities, tests, pages, styles, and conventions before Laravel Inertia component work. Use before creating new components, extracting hooks, adding variants, or changing shared UI.
purpose: Prevent duplicate components, inconsistent APIs, and design drift by checking local code and conventions first.
inputs: Required: - Component goal or target file. - Project root. Optional: - Known component names. - Related routes, pages, or screenshots.
outputs: - Relevant existing files. - Conventions to follow. - Similar APIs and patterns. - Gaps or duplication risks.
responsibilities: Search existing components, sections, pages, hooks, libraries, styles, and tests.
Identify reusable primitives and local design patterns.
Identify installed supporting skills and docs that already govern the touched domain.
success_criteria: The skill stays within its focused responsibility.
The workflow and decision points are followed.
Validation checklist items are satisfied or skipped checks are reported.
Cross-skill handoffs are explicit when another skill owns the next concern.
validation_criteria: SKILL.md loads as the entry point.
AGENTS.md provides the compiled agent guide.
